meta.title: SLATE research: vehicle service shops, maintenance, repairs, customization and rentals
meta.method: WebSearch and WebFetch on 2026-10-01. Every figure carries the URL it came from and the date it was read (2026-10-01 unless a publication date is given). Where a figure was not published or could not be read, it is null with a note. Figures read only through a search-engine summary, not from the page itself, are marked confidence 'search-summary'. Secondary aggregators are marked sourceType 'secondary'.
corrections_to_brief: NCT is no longer EUR 55: from 1 January 2025 the full NCT is EUR 60 and a retest needing equipment EUR 40 (was EUR 55 and EUR 28). Source: https://www.irishexaminer.com/news/arid-41535299.html and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Car_Test (search summary, 2026-10-01).
Ford Puma's bolt pattern is 5x108, not 4x108 (wheel-size.com lists it as 5x4.25 in).

The 2019+ North American Corolla (E210) is 5x100 with a 54.1 mm bore; one secondary source (kipardoracing) says 5x114.3 'most global models' but gives a 54.1 mm bore, which belongs to Toyota's 5x100 hubs. 5x100 is the figure taken.
California's ride-height law (Vehicle Code 24008, body lower than the wheel rims) was repealed by AB 436, signed 13 Oct 2023, effective 1 Jan 2024.

Ontario's Highway Traffic Act s.73(3) has no numeric VLT for front side windows: the test is 'substantially obscures the interior'. The 70% figure seen on tint-shop sites is a shop rule of thumb, not statute.
BC's AirCare emissions program ended 31 Dec 2014; Ontario's Drive Clean ended for light vehicles 1 Apr 2019. Neither city has a periodic inspection of private cars.
meta.currency_note: US prices USD before sales tax; Canada CAD (shops usually quote before HST/GST+PST); UK GBP incl. VAT unless stated '+VAT'; Ireland EUR incl. VAT; Mexico MXN incl. IVA unless stated.
